SPY.rationale: Broad market tone remains mixed ahead of FOMC meeting. SPY closed at $734.54 on June 11 (+1.26%) after prior 1.62% selloff on June 10. 2026 EPS growth +24% forecast supports underlying resilience, but elevated valuations and soft sentiment limit upside.
SPY.headline: S&P 500 navigates elevated valuations ahead of June 16-17 FOMC; EPS growth +24% but sentiment soft

CSCO.rationale: BofA raised price target to $150 from $135 on June 8; stock up 61% YTD on strong AI security demand and networking partnerships. No breaking news June 11-12, but momentum constructive.
CSCO.headline: Cisco price target raised to $150 by BofA; 61% YTD gain on AI infrastructure momentum

GOOGL.rationale: Multiple bullish catalysts: Google I/O 2026 AI announcements (agents, search updates); Waymo $30 robotaxi membership launch; TD Cowen raised price target to $475 from $450. Stock traded $343-$359 on June 11, near mid-range.
GOOGL.headline: Google I/O 2026 AI agents and search updates; Waymo robotaxi launches $30 membership; TD Cowen PT raised to $475

JNJ.rationale: Recent Q1 2026 earnings beat with raised FY2026 guidance to ~$100.8B revenue. New launches (Icotyde, Inlexzo) and $1B Firefly Bio oncology acquisition (announced June 8) replacing Stelara losses. Analyst consensus: 12 Strong Buys, 3 Moderate, 10 Hold, 0 Sells; Street-high target $280 (HSBC) implying 17% upside.
JNJ.headline: JNJ raised FY2026 revenue guidance; new drug launches and $1B oncology acquisition offsetting Stelara losses

NVDA.rationale: NVDA announced significant dividend increase on June 11; stockholder meeting set June 24; Oracle confirms strong AI demand and data center expansion (positive for chipmakers). However, stock fell ~$260B in market value amid mega-cap tech pressure; traded $199-$206 on June 12. Analyst upside target ~50% but high volatility near-term.
NVDA.headline: NVDA raises dividend; Oracle reaffirms AI demand; but mega-cap tech selloff pressures stock near-term

UNH.rationale: Six major analyst upgrades in late May/early June 2026: Bernstein $492, Morgan Stanley $453, BofA $450, JPMorgan $466. Stock rebounded from 52-week low to $407. Ex-dividend June 15 ($2.32/share). Major risk: DOJ antitrust probe into Optum divestiture could invalidate thesis.
UNH.headline: UNH upgraded 6 times in 2 weeks; analyst targets $450-$492; ex-dividend June 15; antitrust risk flagged

XOM.rationale: Stock down 2.67% on June 11 to $146.60, despite 22.8% YTD and 42.2% 1-year returns. Crude oil fell 4.46% on June 12 (to $83.80) after Trump suspended Iran strikes and signaled peace talks. Geopolitical de-risking pressures energy near-term.
XOM.headline: Oil down 4.46% on Iran peace talks; XOM pressure from geopolitical de-risking

GLD.rationale: Gold fell to 4-month low ($4,080/oz) on June 11; recovered slightly but remains under pressure. Drivers: (1) stronger May nonfarm payrolls lifting rate-hike odds; (2) ECB rate hike; (3) dollar strength; (4) Iran peace deal reducing geopolitical premium. GLD traded $372-$389 on June 11-12.
GLD.headline: Gold falls to 4-month low amid stronger USD, rising rate-hike odds, Iran peace optimism

ppi_may_2026.headline: May 2026 PPI: +1.1% MoM (seasonally adjusted); +6.5% YoY
ppi_may_2026.summary: Producer Price Index rose 1.1% in May on monthly basis; 12-month rise of 6.5% (largest since Nov 2022's 7.4%). Energy component drove gains.
ppi_may_2026.impact: Inflation-sensitive; supports near-term rate-hike probability for FOMC June 16-17 meeting

cpi_may_2026.headline: May 2026 CPI: +0.5% MoM (seasonally adjusted); +4.2% YoY
cpi_may_2026.summary: Consumer Price Index rose 0.5% in May after 0.6% in April; 12-month increase 4.2%. Energy index rose 3.9% (accounted for 60% of monthly gain).
cpi_may_2026.impact: Moderating monthly but elevated YoY; influences FOMC bias shift discussion on June 16-17

jobless_claims.headline: Jobless claims June 6, 2026: 229K (highest since Feb); 4-week MA +4,250 week-over-week
jobless_claims.summary: Initial claims rose to 229K from 225K; beat expectations (219K forecast). Continuing claims +24K to 1.795M (vs 1.780M expected). Labor market still strong but showing early signs of softening.
jobless_claims.impact: Mixed signal: resilience remains but 4-week MA spike (fastest single-week climb) may concern Fed

fomc_meeting_june_16_17.headline: FOMC June 16-17: Kevin Warsh's first meeting as Chair; no rate change expected, but bias shift likely (easing → neutral/tightening)
fomc_meeting_june_16_17.summary: Policy statement at 2pm ET June 17; Chair Warsh presides first time. Expectations: hold rates steady but shift from dovish to neutral stance. Warsh sworn in May 22; his communication may signal future tightening bias.
fomc_meeting_june_16_17.impact: Tier-1 catalyst. Outcome will drive bond yields, USD strength, equities; soft signals likely support risk assets, hawkish shift could pressure growth stocks

oil_geopolitical.headline: Iran peace talks progress: Trump suspends planned attacks; crude WTI falls 4.46% to $83.80
oil_geopolitical.summary: Trump signaled US-Iran agreement possible by weekend; suspended military action. Oil fell from $87.86 (June 11) to $83.80 (June 12) as geopolitical premium deflates.
oil_geopolitical.impact: Energy sector headwind (XOM pressure); but positive for inflation narrative, supports FOMC 'soft landing' case

earnings_check.june_12_13: No major earnings announcements found for SPY (ETF), CSCO, GOOGL, JNJ, NVDA, UNH, XOM on June 12-13, 2026. Next catalyst window TBD.
earnings_check.note: Earnings calendars (Yahoo Finance, Nasdaq, Investing.com) did not report earnings for portfolio names on these dates.

summary_for_downstream_agents: Market tone MIXED ahead of FOMC June 16-17. Bullish names: GOOGL (I/O AI announcements, Waymo), JNJ (guidance beat, acquisitions), UNH (six analyst upgrades), CSCO (AI momentum). Bearish: XOM (oil collapse on Iran peace), GLD (gold 4-month low, stronger USD, rate hike odds). SPY NEUTRAL (resilient EPS but elevated valuations). NVDA MIXED (dividend bull but mega-cap selloff). Macro: May CPI/PPI suggest inflation sticky (supporting rate-hike bias), but jobless claims show labor softening (4-week MA spike). FOMC June 16-17 is the critical event—likely neutral bias shift (not easing, not aggressive tightening) = moderate positive for risk assets. Oil geopolitical tailwind for inflation narrative. No major earnings within 24h.
